tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (kha)༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor bzhugs/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ /rang gzhan bsrung dang bza
(kha)༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor bzhugs/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ /rang gzhan bsrung dang bza

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor bzhugs// dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// rang gzhan bsrung dang bzlog pa dang*// bsod nams spel dang dngos grub ster// de dag sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa// dur khrod la sogs dben gnas su// maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor bshams nas su// bdag nyid yi dam gzhung bzhin bsgom// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// g.yas na thod dbyug 'bar ba thogs// g.yon na thod pa khrag bkang gsol// 'bar ba'i keng rus mche ba gtsigs// brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul// 'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum bsgom// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā bsrung na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru/ sngags gcig brjod pas bdag nyid bsrung*// tshar gnyis brjod pas gzhan bsrung 'gyur// tshar gsum brjod pas grong bsrung 'gyur// tshar bdun brjod pas shes rab 'phel// brgya rtsa brjod pas yul khams bsrung*// de nas rig sngags bzlog pa ni// dur khrod thal chen blangs nas ni// chos skyong yab yum sku bzhengs la// spyan drangs rab tu gnas par bya// nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la// rme ba nag po'i dud pas bdug /rig sngags zlog ces gsol ba gdab// de yis rig sngags bzlog par 'gyur// dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa// 'brub khung khru gang khrag gis byugs// zur gsum nang du mchog phur gsum// btsugs pa'i kha ru thod pa gzhag /kha zas sna tshogs mchog gis bkang*// 'bru sna sman sna rat+na brdar// zur gsum la ni ba liṃ gzhag /dus drug chang skrad g.yon skor gsog /gtor ma mi gshegs gta' ru gzung*// zhag bdun bar du smra bcad bya// dam tshig bsrung ba mchog tu gces// sgrub pa thon nas dngos grub blang*// zhag bdun lon pa'i nang par ni// dpal ldan yab yum gus pa yi// tshul gyis dngos grub drangs par bsam// rgyun gtor gnyis po gtsang sar bskyal// de nas las tshogs sgrub pa'i thabs// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// sna tshogs 'bru las byas nas su// bang mdzod bcug la gsol ba gdab// de yi 'bru rnams 'phel bar 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// rat+na sna tshogs dag las bya// zhing dkyil bcug na lo legs 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// thab 'og bcug na longs spyod 'du// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// gser dang g.yus bris rab gnas bya// chu ra'i zhabs su sbas gyur na// zas kyi spyan gzigs 'phel bar 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// tā la'i lo ma dag la bris// gang gi mgul du btags gyur na// de la thams cad dad par 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dar dkar la sogs dag la bris// dmag dpon dag gi mgo la btsugs// de yis dmag rnams bsrung bar 'gyur// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// rat+na sna tshogs dag gis bri// rab gnas byas la dpung par gdags// yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dri bzang tsan+dan gla bas bri// rab gnas mchod pa rab tu bya// sgo steng btags na nad rnams bsrung*/

dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// ras la bris la rab gnas bya// bla re byas la gsol ba gdab// de yis bdag gzhan bar chad bsrung*// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// gsum du byas la rab gnas bya// pha la gcig gdags ma la gcig /bu tsha la gcig gdags par bya// chung sri chings shig gsol ba gdab// sri'u gso bar bya ba'o// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// 'bur sku byas la rgyab yol nang*// bcug na grwa pa 'phel bar 'gyur// nang par tshar bdun yi dam bya// de yis shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur// yungs kar thal chen la bsngags te// zhing la sogs pa kun la gtor// de yis gdug pa kha chings 'gyur// gar stabs can gyis gang bar bsam// ras bal skud pa dkar po la// bsngags la mdud pa nyer gcig bya// phyugs la btags na gab 'phel 'gyur// dud 'gro bsrung ba'i man ngag ni// lha khang la sogs gyo mo la// gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod// phyugs la sogs pa'i lhas su gtor// bsrung ba'i ting 'dzin gong dang 'dra// chom rkun 'chang ba'i man ngag la// chu'am gsham ma la sogs la// snying po brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod// bdag dang rdzas dang phyogs bcur gtor// chom rkun chings shig gsol ba gdab// mdun dang rgyab kyi gzhogs re nas// lha gnyis gar byed 'gro bar bsam// gnas su phyin nas ting 'dzin glod// de yis 'jigs pa kun las thar// rgyun du srog gi snying po bzlas// lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs// gtor ma dkon mchog mchod pa rab// de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod// rtsa ba'i gsang sngags nyid la ni// shrī sh+ma shā na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun brjod pas gsol bar bsam/ shin tu gsang nas bsgrubs na/ gzhan yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// dpal dur khrod bdag po sha za chen po yab yum kyi sgrub thabs/

bla ma bai ro'i gdams pa'o// i thi// //dpal dur khrod bdag po'i las kyi dum bu ni/ yul du rims nad byung ba la// yul du gtor phye bsdus byas la// bla ma dkon mchog rnams dang ni// dur khrod bdag po yab yum la// mchod dang gtor ma phul nas su// rims nad zlog ces gsol ba gdab// dur khrod thal ba grong la gdab// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam// des ni rims nad bzlog par 'gyur// phyugs la glo gdon byung ba dang*// lug la gtal pa byung ba la// dur khrod thal ba dag dang ni// yungs kar yungs nag bsres byas la// phyugs kyi lhas su gtor bar bya// des ni mi phyugs nad rnams khegs// //na mo gu ra we/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang ba cig de'i steng du rin po che gnyis bris la/ de'i steng du nas 'ga' spung ngo*// de'i steng du man dzi bzhag de'i steng du rten gtor bzhag de'i steng du yang gtor bzhag mdun du rgyun gtor yang gzhag par bya// gzhan yang dkon mchog la mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ lha bsgom/ mchod gtor dbul/ de nas nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsnyen pa bya'o// dus rgyun du gtor ma bshams la/ yab yum la bsngos la gsol ba gdab/ de nas thams cad du bdag yi dam mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par bya/ de nas dus thams cad du yab yum dpag tu med pas bskor zhing bar chad bsal bar bsams shing gsol ba gdab/ ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par bya/ dmag dang rims gang yang bsrung ba'i thabs la/ mchod gtor dbul ba man ngag bzhin bya ste/ dgra la tho rangs bya/ nad rims la nges pa med do// de yang gong dang 'dra'o// man ngag tu mis ma tshor bar bya'o// gar stabs can gyis nang nas gdug pa sel bar bsam mo// rgyun gtor chang skrad bdun bdun bzhag rten gtor steng du dung gnyis bzhag sha dang khrag gi ri bo dang rgya mtshor bsams pa'i steng du/

dung gnyis la yab yum bskyed pa dang bstim par bya'o// rgyun gtor sngags bdun bdun la khā hi khā hi btags la dbul/ 'dzin gtor mi gshegs gta' ru gzung*/ de yang dus drug tu chang bu re re bdun bdun gcig gcig bzhin du g.yon skor bya'o// lan bdun gyis gong ba'i tshad bya/ mtshams khong du bud med mi gtang*/ sgrub pa'i yig chung yin no// //na mo gu ra we/ tsakra'i rab gnas bya ba ni/ bdag yi dam gyi lhar mos te/ rtsa ba'i bla mas gtso byas pa'i bla ma rnams mdun du spyan drangs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dmar po de'i phyag rgya'i nang du tshud par bsams la pū dza phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag lam log pa las bskyab tu gsol/ chom rkun las bskyab tu gsol/ gcan gzan kyi 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol/ de la sogs pa gang 'dod gsol ba gdab/ de la sngags 'di rten 'brel snying po la gdags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la/ sku gsung thugs la bstim mo// rab gnas so// rdzogs so// //gu ru sar+b+ba smain maḥ shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// bde ba'i stan la rab 'dug ste// dur khrod sa las maṇ+ḍal ni// gru bzhi mda' gang tshad du bya// steng du zlum po khru gang bya// de yi steng du gru gsum bya// chang dang khrag gis byug par bya// zur gsum dag la mchog phur gsum// steng du mtshan bzang ka pā la// nang du kha zas mchog gis dgang*// thabs dang shes rab nor bu gnyis// sgrub pa'i rten du bcang bar bya// dkar po dar gyi zhal khebs bya// dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku// dmigs pa'i rten du dgram par bya// de nas yan lag bdun pa bya// tshad med bzhi yi sems kyis sbyangs// de nas stong pa'i ngang nyid las// bdag nyid yi dam lha ru bskyed// dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni// sku mdog dkar po 'jigs pa'i sku// spyan gsum nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bgrad// phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba ste// g.yon pa na ni thod khrag 'dzin// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs tshul// bdag gi mdun du bsgom par bya// g.yas su dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams bskyed// g.yon du dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams bskyed// mdun gyi bar snang dag la ni// bud+dha bo dhi sa twa dang*// bla ma yi dam rnams kyang bsam// de nas gtor ma dbul ba ni// 'byung po'i gtor ma bzhin du bya// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni// oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza/

ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ tshar gcig bzlas na shes rab 'phel// brgya yis bdag nyid srung bar byed// stong gis yon bdag srung bar byed// de ni sgrub pa'i man ngag go /i thi// //gu ra we na maḥ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rten sba ba ni/ rat+na bkra shis pa'i sa las/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku byas la/ dri bzang gis byugs/ ras sam dar dkar la tsakra zur brgyad pa bris la dbus su rin po che la oṃ bri/ zur brgyad la rin po che brgyad bris la/ mu khyud la oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza/ ku ma za ku ma za khuṃ this swā hā/ rat+na ghṛ che ge mo sems sgul sgul bya ba bri/ tsakra la rab gnas bya/ yab yum gyi sku'i lte bar bcug la/ de rang gi bang mdzod du sba'o// des ni mi rnams g.yo ba dang*/ nor 'phel ba dang*/ tshe ring ba dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur 'gyur ro// i thi// //he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku mdun du bsams la/ mchod pa rnam lnga bsham/ a ga ru dang*/ tu ruṣ+ka dang*/ gu gul nag po dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pa 'tshogs tshad bsags/ dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa'i tshogs rgya chen po bshams la/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ dkyil 'khor bri/ logs bzhir g.yung drung re re bri/ g.yung drung ris bzhi po la dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis po bsam/ bla ma yi dam rnam gnyis bsam/ de rnams spyan drangs la/ yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig bya/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad dur khrod yab yum la dbul/ srod la tshogs 'khor rnams bla ma dang*/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum la dbul/ rang re ngoms la tshim par bya/ gtor ma gsum po gshegs su gsol/ dus bzang rnams la mtshams re bya/ nyi ma shar ma thag re bza'/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer kha dog dkar dmar gnyis byon/ de rang gi lce thog tu byon nas sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bgrang*/

yab yum gyi sku sor gcig pa bris la/ nu ma g.yon pa'i thog tu gdags/ skya rengs shar tsa na bskor ba gsum dang phyag gsum bya/ de bdag la dga' zhing mgu bar 'du ba yin no// i thi// //gu ra we na maḥ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sha za chen po yab yum gyis dam nyams pa sgrol ba'i thabs/ dur khrod dam dben pa'i gnas su/ mi pho mo tshad rims kyis shi ba'i shul nas sa blangs la/ de la gru gsum mkhyid gang bya/ nang dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs/ dur khrod sol ba la rat+na brdar la/ khrag gis sbrus la/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gzugs sor brgyad pa byas la zhal sbyar/ dug khrag gis che ge mo'i ming rus bris la/ de'i bar du mgo thur du bstan la bzhag gru gsum nang du liṅga de dang 'dra ba bris la gzhug steng du dar gur nag po phug rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig la dur sol gyis byugs/ gru gsum gyi kha la srin mo 'gros su bskor/ sha khrag dang chang las byas pa'i ba liṃ ta bsham/ thun rdzas ni zangs sam lcags las byas pa'i phye ma dang*/ dug sna tshogs bsags la yi dam bsgom/ de'i mdun du skad cig gis dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsgom/ sku mdog dkar po nag po gnyis mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas khram shing dang*/ g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor sha za'i bdag po dang bdag mo dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ ye shes pa bstim/ yang gtor ma sha khrag gi bdud rtsir dmigs la/ rtsa sngags bdun gyis dbul/ thal mo brdab/ phrin las bcol/ de'i rjes la thun rdzas rnams dur khrod kyi bdag mo yungs 'bru tsam mang por bsams la thun bya/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza/ ghṛ rā dza/ che ge mo tiṃ tiṃ ku ma ku ma khuṃ this/ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad rbad/ ces mang du bzlas so// de lta bu zla ba phyed phyed bar du smra bcad bya/ mtshan ma ni nges pa med/

cho 'phrul ci yang ston te skrag par mi bya'o// de nas liṅga dang sku de rnams dar nag tu gril nas/ lho phyogs kyi dur khrod du mnan no// lo ma 'gor bar chad pa'i las kyis 'chi'o// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sha za chen po yab yum gyi drag po'i las rdzogs so// shin tu gsang ba gal che'o// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyis lus dang grib ma bzhin du sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig ma g.yel cig zab bo// 'di la yid ches so// nyams myong can yin no// i thi// //oṃ shang ka ra/ shang tser/ shag dug raṃ dug tser nan/ brag dang brag tu shag lug ru pho mchin shag khas// //smyo 'dul na/ sha chen/ yungs kar/ gu gul nag po/ so ba/ rgya skyegs/ ldong ros/ mu zi/ ro bsregs thal ba rnams nad pas ma tshor bar bsreg rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis nad pa'i mdun du sol me la rdzas brgyad po bsregs pa'i dud pa phyir mi 'chor bar byas la 'dug yugs sa'i skra shad kyis nad pa'i ske nas bcings la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ sngags bzla zhing khas ma blangs bar du lag pa g.yas pas yungs kar dang*/ so bas brab sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur byung byung bya/ de ma byung na 'dre ma yin pas sman bcos bya/ 'phar ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang*/ ngu ba dang*/ dgod pa la sogs byung na 'dre yin pas/ sngar bzhin gzir zhing gzhan cig 'drir bcug kyang thul lo// zab bo// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
